contents.name: §11.2.2.6: the classical positivity characterization of Lusztig's canonical basis for SL(n)
contents.reason: The displayed statement characterizes the classical SL(n) canonical basis by positivity of matrix elements and contains no quantum bar, form or divided-power dictionary; QG-5's agreement theorem is therefore built on Kashiwara's stated $A_n,D_n,E_n$ agreement with the Lusztig locators, not on this classical characterization.
